To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the wake functions of a structure can be described by a spectral function, that the spectral function of the DDS1 structure is well approximated by a sum of Gaussians, and that the wake function moments of the DDS1 are well approximated by an array of Gaussians.

the wake functions of a damped detuned structure can be expressed in terms of a single spectral function and that the wake functions caused by a structure misalignment are given by the same spectral function array with the addition of an offset term.

(1) the spectral function array is the most general representation for wake functions; (2) the wake moments can be expressed in terms of the spectral function array; and (3) the wake moments are the only wake quantities that are invariant to the choice of reference planes.
